title: Production Layer: User Interface
text: User Interface bertanggung jawab untuk: Chat UI; Mode switcher; Workflow board; Monitoring dashboard; Feedback capture. Health check: UI loads and can call /api/status

title: Production Layer: API Gateway
text: API Gateway bertanggung jawab untuk: Rate limit; Request validation; Session ID normalization; Streaming and JSON fallback. Health check: All API routes return structured JSON or stream

title: Production Layer: Intent Router
text: Intent Router bertanggung jawab untuk: Auto route Quran, Universal, Coding, Companion, Workflow; Sensitive topic safety classification. Health check: Router gives mode + confidence + reasons

title: Production Layer: Memory System
text: Memory System bertanggung jawab untuk: Short-term session; Long-term preference; Interaction summary; User feedback memory. Health check: Session and memory files are created in storage/

title: Production Layer: Retrieval Layer
text: Retrieval Layer bertanggung jawab untuk: Quran RAG; Universal RAG; Workflow RAG; Hybrid lexical/vector-lite scoring. Health check: Relevant top-k sources returned

title: Production Layer: Model Layer
text: Model Layer bertanggung jawab untuk: Ollama offline; OpenAI optional; Coder model routing; Inference profile. Health check: Model responds with acceptable latency

title: Production Layer: Guardrails & Validator
text: Guardrails & Validator bertanggung jawab untuk: Islamic safety; Sensitive topic disclaimers; Anti-hallucination style cleanup; Output format control. Health check: No fabricated ayat/hadith/source in guarded mode

title: Production Layer: Evaluation & Monitoring
text: Evaluation & Monitoring bertanggung jawab untuk: Golden test set; Feedback labels; Latency/error logs; Dataset quality metrics; Improvement backlog. Health check: /api/evaluate and /api/monitoring are usable

title: Rate Limit API
text: Rate limit menjaga backend AI agar tidak overload. Pada local-first project, rate limit bisa berupa in-memory window per IP/session sebelum memakai Redis atau database.

title: Feedback Loop
text: Feedback loop menyimpan penilaian user terhadap jawaban. Label seperti helpful, wrong_context, hallucination, atau too_long dipakai untuk perbaikan dataset, prompt, dan retrieval.

title: Golden Evaluation Set
text: Golden evaluation set adalah kumpulan pertanyaan uji tetap. Set ini dipakai untuk memastikan upgrade AI tidak merusak kemampuan lama.

title: Vector-lite Retrieval
text: Vector-lite retrieval adalah pendekatan ringan tanpa dependency berat yang mengubah teks menjadi fingerprint token/karakter untuk menghitung kemiripan. Ini bukan pengganti embedding sungguhan, tapi cukup untuk local dev.

title: Deployment Profile
text: Deployment profile memisahkan konfigurasi local, staging, dan production. Tujuannya supaya model, logging, rate limit, dan provider tidak tercampur.

title: AI Observability
text: AI observability mencakup request count, latency, error rate, source hit rate, mode distribution, dan feedback trend.
